verdict.rationale: Draft A provides deeper causal analysis, better coverage of red flags and watch items, and clearer separation of facts from judgments. Draft B has some unsupported claims and less precise grounding. A's use of specific thresholds and peer comparisons adds value.

Draft B provides more granular segment and geographic detail, explains margin drivers with specific cost lines, and includes off-balance-sheet commitments. Its claims are well-supported by cited passages. Draft A is solid but less deep and misses the lease commitments. B's extra depth and coverage outweigh minor clarity differences.
